nb421b3d6e7.headline: Ibex closes with a rebound of almost 2% supported by the banking sector
nb421b3d6e7.summary: The Ibex-35 index rose by almost 2% following reassuring economic data from China and positive macro figures in the United States, boosting market expectations.
nb421b3d6e7.why: The Ibex-35 is Spain's benchmark stock index, and its movement reflects investor sentiment on economic conditions and corporate earnings in Spain and globally.

impacts.name: Ibex-35
impacts.why: Positive economic data from China and the US improved market sentiment, lifting Spain's benchmark index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nb421b3d6e7.why_moved: Reassuring economic data from China and the US boosted investor confidence, supporting a rebound in Spain's Ibex-35 index, especially in the banking sector.
